title: Naboo N-1 Starfighter
description: Naboo was a planet known for its handcrafted elegance, exemplified by its royal starfighters. The N-1 was easily recognizable and well known for its beauty. Peli Motto found one in a scrap heap and decided this would be the perfect ship for the Mandalorian. When the Mandalorian was contacted about the ship, he thought he was coming to pick up a replacement for the Razor Crest. However, Peli Motto convinced him to help her restore the antique beauty after her bait and switch, creating a ship fast enough to outrun the X-wing patrols that frequented the Outer Rim.
